items.title: Shops, teleports and Ghommal's lucky charms
items.summary: Shops restocked and the teleports reworked. Ghommal's lucky ring is in: 10% chance to heal 10 on a kill, 1.5x boss points, 4% drop rate. Buy the penny from the Boss points Store and upgrade a ring of wealth (i) into one.

items.title: Clue scrolls point where they should
items.summary: Map clues were sending you to the wrong spot about one step in five, which is fixed. We went through every other step too and pulled the ones you could not finish, like anagrams no clue helper recognised and NPCs that were not in the game. Music steps used to ask for tracks you had no way to get, so all music is unlocked.

items.title: Town Board reworked
items.summary: There's a 20 level ladder behind the board now, with rewards on nine of them and a permanent 3% drop rate at the top. Town Points have somewhere to go too. Spend them at the Exchange on rerolls, an extra task slot, or wiping the board for a fresh set. Tasks and targets were redone as well.

items.title: Every skilling teleport is on the menu
items.summary: 41 of the 47 skilling teleports could only be reached by typing a search. They are all listed now. The dead Misc button became Recent on every spellbook, and the dungeon entrance teleports go where they say instead of claiming Edgeville.

items.title: Boss mechanics switched on
items.summary: Dagannoth Kings spawn their spinolyps, so the moat is a threat instead of scenery. Bryophyta summons her growthlings. Abyssal Sire's last form is properly tanky and swings at the right speed, the ToA Wardens are back on their real timing, and Doom's rock knocks you off your tile. Eleven bosses shared between slayer and raids were also blocking Combat Achievements for everyone, which is sorted.

items.title: Drop rate bonuses now actually help
items.summary: Every drop rate source was checked against what it claimed. The bonus is applied the right way round now, so the rarest drops on over a thousand tables are reachable again. Kills count every time something dies rather than only the first, so respawns build your rates properly. Two boss tables were also handing out uniques twice as often as they should.

items.title: Monsters fight back properly now
items.summary: 418 monsters around the world were going down in a single hit, cave horrors among them, and another 55 were attacking at the wrong speed. They all have their real stats.

items.title: Moons collection log + Lunar Chest
items.summary: Moons of Peril collection log page is in. The Lunar Chest now works like the raid chests: kill moons, open it in the Ancient Shrine, take or bank your loot.

items.title: Moons boss HP bars + kill checklist
items.summary: All three Moons show the boss health overlay, and a checklist tracks your kills per trip. Eclipse clone phase and searing rays polished. Upgrade table examine fixed.

items.title: Blood Moon & Eclipse Moon full fights
items.summary: Both moons now run their complete fights: Blood Rain, the jaguar heal race, the Moon Shield and the clone phase. Achievements system is live.

items.title: Content and fixes batch
items.summary: Bolt pouch, three elven shops, quiver ammo pickup, GE tax 2%, upgrade table rework, and a big round of combat and skilling corrections.

items.title: The Maggot King
items.summary: New boss from The Blood Moon Rises in his Vampyrium lair under Castle Drakan, with 30+ new items ported from the update.

items.title: Sol Heredit, Prestige and more
items.summary: Sol Heredit is a real fight with a reward chest. Prestige system, redesigned teleport menu, smarter drop viewer, and hundreds of fixes.

items.title: Pre-launch audit sweep
items.summary: Big cleanup round: dupe and security fixes, drop table corrections, collection log repairs, and the Inferno completion reward.

items.title: Yama gear and item fixes
items.summary: Oathplate and more endgame gear ported in, item stats corrected across the board, and a round of interface and bank fixes.

items.title: Sigils reworked, and the Crucible of Conviction
items.summary: The sigil system got a rework, with the Codex and the Crucible of Conviction alongside it. New welcome and starter task screens too.

items.title: Munity Beta is live
items.summary: Server is up and open for testing. All progress wipes before full launch.

items.title: Scurrius and Yama reworks
items.summary: Scurrius is now a proper 3-phase fight. Yama glyphs swap cleanly, Judge bug fixed. Yama takes +20% from demonbane and +50% from water spells.

items.title: Combat, specs and interfaces
items.summary: Tonalztics Division special added. Purging Staff demonbane 20% to 40% and stacks with Mark of Darkness. Blue Moon Frost Storm and Weapon Freeze reworked.

items.title: Moons of Peril and Hueycoatl
items.summary: New bosses: Blood Moon, Blue Moon, Eclipse Moon, The Hueycoatl. New gear: Blue Moon Spear, Soulflame Horn, Oathplate set, Sunlight Crossbow.
